PASS|foot-tier-strong|"📎 Attach
i
WHAT
Attach text files (JSON, Markdown, CSV…) to your message.
WHY
The file content is read into the turn and stays in the conversation, so follow-ups can keep working on it.
E.G.
Upload an n8n workflow spec and ask Protean to build the workflow JSON.
Tier · strong
i
WHAT
The speed/quality tier answering you.
WHY
Fast answers simple turns cheaply; Strong reasons more deeply but costs more and takes longer.
Domain · finance
i
WHAT
The active domain pack (vocabulary, tools, and behaviour).
WHY
Protean shape-shifts per domain — switching packs changes how answers are framed, with no code change.
E.G.
Finance / CFO’s-CFO analyst"
